C0137.title: Black-market gang offering discounted membership top-ups dismantled by police
C0137.summary: In October 2023, Hangzhou cyber police uncovered a black-market gang exploiting a vulnerability in Apple's in-app purchase mechanism to tamper with payment credential data and disrupt authentication, enabling low-price membership purchases that were resold on C2C platforms, causing direct losses of over 1.8 million yuan to the company. On November 17, Hangzhou police carried out coordinated raids in Luoyang (Henan) and Bozhou (Anhui), arresting four suspects.
